endpoints.summary: Run scaffold-hopping generation. Returns a JobInfo; poll until completed.
endpoints.description: Run scaffold-hopping generation. Returns a JobInfo; poll until completed.

request_fields.name: num_samples
request_fields.description: Number of scaffold candidates to generate (1–100). Sampling is a single batched forward pass — runtime scales sub-linearly.

request_fields.name: model_variant
request_fields.description:
Which trained model to use:
- gvp_conditional   : DiffHopp (recommended); ligand-conditioned
- gvp_unconditional : DiffHopp inpainting (no functional-group conditioning)
- egnn_conditional  : DiffHopp-EGNN (EGNN backbone, conditional)
- egnn_unconditional: DiffHopp-EGNN inpainting

examples.title: basic scaffold hopping (10 candidates, GVP-conditional)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/generate -F protein=@1abc_pocket.pdb -F reference_ligand=@ref.sdf -F num_samples=10 -F model_variant=gvp_conditional
examples.notes: Smallest useful call. Returns a JobInfo; poll /api/jobs/<id> until completed, then GET /api/jobs/<id>/files.

examples.title: EGNN variant with inpainting (no functional-group conditioning)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/generate -F protein=@pocket.pdb -F reference_ligand=@ref.mol2 -F num_samples=20 -F model_variant=egnn_unconditional
examples.notes: Use *_unconditional variants when you want the model to ignore the reference ligand's functional groups.

examples.title: FC async task mode (single 202 + blocking compute)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/tasks/generate -H 'X-Fc-Invocation-Type: Async' -H 'X-Bioagent-Job-Id: my-job-001' -F protein=@pocket.pdb -F reference_ligand=@ref.sdf -F num_samples=10
examples.notes: Returns 202 immediately; FC keeps the instance alive until the diffusion completes. Use this for production calls behind the FC async-task console toggle.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: DiffHopp
model.task: scaffold hopping (de novo molecule design via graph diffusion)

tool_outputs.generate: output/output_<i>.sdf — one SDF per generated scaffold (i in [0, num_samples)). Files where the generated graph couldn't be assembled into a valid Mol are omitted.

config_tips.num_samples: 10 is a reasonable default; sampling is batched, so 50 takes ~4× a single sample, not 50×.
config_tips.model_variant: Start with gvp_conditional (DiffHopp main, paper's primary result). Switch to *_unconditional for inpainting scenarios where the reference ligand's functional group should NOT bias generation.

input_uri_schemes.oss://<bucket>/<key>: fetched at submit-time via configured OSS region
